I teach applied, code-first courses: every topic is anchored in a dataset and a case, and students write code from the first session. Course material is shared with enrolled students through the institute's learning platform.

## Madras School of Economics (2026 onwards)

| Course | Programme | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Statistics with R | M.Sc. Data Science | Probability, distributions, sampling, estimation and hypothesis testing, taught entirely through R on case datasets. |
| Introduction to Artificial Intelligence | M.Sc. Data Science | Search, constraint satisfaction, reasoning under uncertainty, and knowledge graphs, with Python notebooks. |
| Programming in SQL | MBA | Relational modelling and MySQL 8, from single-table queries to analytics-style window functions, with a short bridge to NoSQL and BI. |

## Executive and faculty development

Management Development Programmes on data and business analytics for organisations including PwC, the Reserve Bank of India and GMR, and Faculty Development Programmes for faculty and research scholars from IITs, IIMs, IMT and other institutes. Details on the [Workshops](workshops.qmd) page.
